C api019.distinguish OL API-019 DEFAULT ;; Health checks answer alive/ready; distinguish liveness from readiness when the deployment infrastructure benefits. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api019.liveness-avoids-deps OL API-019 DEFAULT ;; A liveness probe usually avoids databases and remote APIs. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hc-readiness-tags EX API-019 DEFAULT ;; Register readiness checks with tags (and map readiness endpoints by tag). ;; = ;; none ;; Tagging technique (EXC-010).
C api019.required-deps OL API-019 MUST ;; Include only dependencies required for meaningful readiness; optional services do not necessarily make the app unready. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api019.startup-readiness OL API-019 MUST ;; Readiness stays unhealthy until required startup work completes; do not use liveness for this (restart loops). ;; = ;; none ;;
C api018.db-light OL API-018 MUST ;; Database health is a lightweight connectivity check without expensive queries, scans or writes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hc-framework-integration EX API-018 DEFAULT ;; Use provider/framework health-check integration where suitable. ;; = ;; Where suitable. ;; Implementation preference not in the oracle.
C api019.no-cascades OL API-019 AVOID ;; Check external dependencies only when important to readiness; avoid readiness cascades/remote dependency chains; prefer lightweight capability checks. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hc-status-mapping EX API-019 MUST_NOT ;; Health endpoints return success when healthy and non-success when unhealthy per probe policy; do not reuse business API status semantics mechanically for probes. ;; = ;; none ;; Probe status semantics outside the oracle.
C api020.small-protected OL API-020 MUST ;; Keep probe responses small; protect diagnostic endpoints with network/authorization controls. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hc-exposure EX API-020 DEFAULT ;; Choose health endpoint exposure by deployment topology (internal network, management port, host restrictions, authorization where supported). ;; = ;; none ;; Exposure mechanics (EXC-010).
C api018.cheap OL API-018 AVOID ;; Avoid expensive queries, long timeouts, large allocations, full workflows and database writes/business transactions in probes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hc-no-error-logs EX RUN-013 AVOID ;; Avoid Error-level logs for every normal failed probe. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.hc-testing EX TST-003 DEFAULT ;; Test meaningful health configuration when deployment relies on it; no elaborate tests of uncustomized framework behaviour. ;; = ;; When deployment relies on it. ;; Health test obligations not in the oracle.
C x.hc-no-grading EX API-018 AVOID ;; Do not use health checks as a code-quality grading system. ;; = ;; none ;; Not stated in api.md or the oracle.

C run016.match-semantics OL RUN-016,RUN-018 MUST ;; Resilience policies match failure and operation semantics. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.no-resilience-by-default OL GOV-013,DEP-011 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add resilience mechanisms merely because they are available. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.res-observe EX - DEFAULT ;; Observe retries, timeouts and circuit behaviour when material; give important production circuit breakers operational visibility. ;; = ;; When material. ;; Observability obligation not in the oracle.
C dep020.mex-apis OL DEP-020 DEFAULT ;; Application code uses the Microsoft.Extensions resilience APIs rather than configuring Polly directly. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.standard-handler OL RUN-016 MUST ;; The standard handler is optional; review its retry behaviour for state-changing requests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run015.attempt-total OL RUN-015 MUST ;; Distinguish attempt and total operation timeouts, especially with retries. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.no-unsafe-retry OL RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not retry non-idempotent operations without duplicate prevention, every exception/status, or hedge writes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.res-not-retried EX RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not retry validation errors, auth failures, permanent 404s or deterministic business rejections. ;; = ;; none ;; Explicit categories beyond RUN-016.
C run017.prefer-retry-after OL RUN-017 DEFAULT ;; Prefer the server's retry guidance over an independent aggressive schedule. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.duplicate-unsafe OL RUN-016 MUST ;; If repeating a write could duplicate effects automatic retry is unsafe; use API-supported idempotency when appropriate. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.res-no-invented-key EX RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not invent a client-side Idempotency-Key unless the remote service supports it. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in RUN-016.
C x.res-circuit-breaker EX RUN-015 DEFAULT ;; Use a circuit breaker only for meaningful repeated-failure patterns that would add load/latency. ;; = ;; none ;; Circuit breaker technique (EXC-007).
C run016.no-hedged-writes OL RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Hedge only operations safe to execute multiple times; never state-changing operations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.res-db-resilience EX RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not wrap persistence in a generic application retry pipeline; prefer the provider's execution strategy and its transaction/retry guidance; HTTP retry policies are not automatically appropriate for databases. ;; = ;; none ;; Database retry technique (EXC-007).
C x.res-messaging EX RUN-016 DEFAULT ;; Publication retries can duplicate delivery; use idempotent consumers/deduplication/outbox when required and never claim exactly-once because of retries. ;; = ;; When required. ;; Message delivery technique (EXC-007).
C x.res-inbound-429 EX API-003 DEFAULT ;; Inbound rate limiting is distinct from outbound resilience; rejected requests receive 429 with Retry-After when known. ;; = ;; none ;; Rate-limiting semantics not in the oracle.
C run019.cancel-propagate OL RUN-019,RUN-003 MUST ;; Propagate cancellation through resilience pipelines; caller cancellation is not a transient failure to retry. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.no-otel-requirement OL GOV-013,DEP-002 MUST_NOT ;; Do not require OpenTelemetry solely because resilience pipelines exist; use the adopted telemetry stack. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run015.no-overlap OL RUN-015,RUN-017 AVOID ;; Avoid stacked handlers with overlapping strategies and unbounded retry/timeout combinations. ;; = ;; none ;;
